name: Folder Hub
soft_passes: #2 grid — deliberately top-anchored to the notch; lower ~55% is empty dark gradient, focal mass not optically centred
#10 variant robustness — Big Sur era so not strictly in scope, but subject depends entirely on tonal difference within one ramp; would collapse in mono/tinted/dark
#1 mask — composition fits the squircle but mask + drop shadow are baked into the web render, can't verify HIG discipline
#8 depth — layer order coherent but drawer separation so weak the depth barely registers
failures: #3 silhouette — filled solid black it is just a rounded square; notch and drawer are tonal, not shape-bearing
#4 16px squint — notch and low-contrast drawer smear/vanish at menu-bar size; reads as a warm gradient square, not Folder Hub
#7 figure-ground — drawer pill #D38C5E on upper-orange band #DA9460 is 1.09:1, effectively invisible; the actual subject is the least legible element

palette.background: ramp #EB8834->#070202 (bright amber-orange top to near-black base, single hue)

light_model: top-down sky-logic: bright amber at top darkening to near-black at base; drawer pill lit as a raised panel; no visible specular/glass refraction (128px)
layer_stack: lighter warm drawer panel pill (upper third)
[baked squircle mask + drop shadow from the web render]
devices: notch-as-subject (the MacBook hardware notch is the icon's anchor)
the squircle IS the screen (rounded top corners + notch quote a MacBook display's top edge)
drawer panel pill sliding from the notch
long single-hue amber->black vertical ramp, unusually dark for the era
rhymes_hint: minimal gradient-square notch/menu-bar utility icons with one centred motif (NotchNook-style family) — strong subject-mined concept, contrast-starved execution
notes: 128px macapp.supply web render — low res, notch/drawer edges soft, all hex (measured,128px) not exact. Mask + drop shadow baked (not unmasked full-bleed layers). Brand incoherence: marketing cover is a cool electric violet band on black; the icon is warm amber-orange — no shared hue family between icon and brand surface. Watch for an anti-pattern candidate across icons: 'Isoluminant Subject' / 'Tonal Whisper' — a distinctive concept delivered in near-isoluminant tints of one hue (drawer at 1.09:1 here). Only the notch holds contrast (8.1:1) and it is the smallest mark on the canvas.
